verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because LiveKit Agents runs on LiveKit Cloud and LiveKit Inference, where a data-use policy or training opt-out is a fair buyer question. However, nothing in the pack covers whether customer data is used for model training, an opt-out control, or a no-training or data-retention commitment. Self-hosting and bring-your-own-provider options appear only as deployment features and are never framed as training-data protections, so they are not credited here.
